Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the IMFDB Westworld Season 1 page and asserted that The Man in Black (Ed Harris) carries a Remington Model 1875 without evidence. This conflated the presence of Remington revolvers used by other characters with Ed Harris’s weapon, contradicting earlier, correct indications (custom LeMat revolver) and introducing an unsupported conclusion.
